notes.title: New game announced from the creator of Chasing Static 💀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37776207/684f6f2e6aa7fdf0fb4461d75e0a985f18a176f3.png[/img]

Hey all,

I've been quietly working working away on my next project, a spiritual successor to Chasing Static called [b]Hollowbody[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37776207/0c8e70523dd0d6fb231c8a3ed39eb21388307f26.png[/img]

I was blown away by the response to Chasing Static and have been reading each and every one of your reviews/comments to make sure that my next game builds upon any criticisms you had with Static.

Hollowbody is heavily inspired by classic survival horror games of the early 2000's. Titles like Silent Hill 2/3, Rule of Rose and Kuon. I've made sure to carry over the emphasis on narrative and atmosphere that was core to the themes of Chasing Static.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37776207/38f0fccc2d7c58addf4c6969eb66ef2c3bf49139.png[/img]

You can find more information about the story, gameplay and watch the brand new reveal trailer over on my Kickstarter page: 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/headwaregames/hollowbody/]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/headwaregames/hollowbody/[/url]

Or if you'd like to help in another way, you can wishlist the game here on Steam:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123640/Hollowbody/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123640/Hollowbody/[/url]

Thanks again for all your support these past two years. Here's to the next game 🥂

notes.title: Updated to v1.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Firstly, a [i]huge [/i]thank you to all of you for your support with the game's release. I've been truly overwhelmed by the response to the game and couldn't be happier.

I've tried to address some of the issues that have been mentioned so far, these are sort of 'high priority' fixes that (hopefully) shouldn't cause any additional issues on top of fixing what has previously been reported. If you notice any weirdness please let me know if the community forum.

Your save games will continue to work with this patch.



[i]The following patch notes contain some minor spoilers.[/i]

[list]
[b][*] Fixed Erudite achievement and ending trigger[/b]

[i]To obtain the erudite ending and achievement you will need to dispose of three of the wandering spirits using the Modified Loudspeaker, collect 9 notes and scan at least 17 echoes. A brief post-credits scene will also play.[/i]


[b][*] Fixed 'Minty' the sheep[/b]

[i]The sheep at Ground Zero will no longer be stuck in the fence. I cut him loose and added a sign warning him not to do it again. I have also added an additional sheep for good measure.[/i]


[b][*] Fixed issues with bird and rat AI[/b]

[i]Rats now run around and play idle animations. Birds should appear less deranged.[/i]


[b][*] Fixed issue with camera not showing polaroid after use[/b]

[i]This is purely a visual fix but it was bugged in the release build.[/i]


[b][*] Fixed issue when starting Restless Dreams mode directly after finishing the game[/b]

[i]There was an issue with the interface not enabling on the new run of the game, blocking progress at the church scene.[/i]


[b][*] Fixed an unusual bug that caused narration to play (subtitles only) at Ground Zero when it shouldn't.[/b]

[b][*] Added additional visual clues/tutorialisation to the initial FDMD usage in the tunnels.[/b]

[i]Some folks were missing the first echo by the gate downstairs in the tunnels, made it a little more obvious.[/i]


[b][*] Fixed a handful of typos in subtitles.[/b]

[i]Subtitles and voiceover now match for Aneira when talking about the electrician, removed a few audio descriptions from subtitles that were causing confusion.[/i]


[b][*] Added visual clue for initial echo at Ground Zero.[/b]

[b][*] Removed requirement to scan echoes at Ground Zero in a specific order.[/b]

[i]This was causing some players to get a bit stuck at Ground Zero, the stone house echo can now be seen independently of the others.[/i]
[/list]

That's it so far, thanks to those of you who helped track these issues down. I'll continue updating the game and trying to implement as many of your suggestions as possible.

Thanks again for your support this far!

notes.title: Lo-fi adventure Chasing Static is now out with some classic horror puzzling
notes.notes:
Chasing Static is both the name of this lo-fi Welsh horror story and also an accurate description of me attempting to track down a post about it on RPS. Someone's written about it. I just know it. Oh no, we've just mentioned it several times in a roundabout way. Well, I've finally pinned it down—chased the clues and cornered it now that it's launched and I can tell you a thing or two about it. Chasing Static is a swell and spooky story so far with a good chunk of classic horror game puzzling and just a bit of sudden scares. Come on and have a quick look.

notes.title: Chasing Static Demo - Updated to v1.2
notes.notes:
[h2][b]The Chasing Static demo has now been updated to v1.2[/b][/h2]

First of all I wanted to say a huge thank you for all of your support so far! It's been amazing seeing so many positive comments about the demo. Some of you have helped discover a few bugs that slipped through our testing so I've tried to squish 'em with this patch.

[h3][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] Rare issue when using item with fuse box blocking progress.
[*] Various collision/boundary breaking issues
[*] Coffee pot/mug casting shadows.
[*] Can look behind during the second car sequence.
[*] Inventory accessible in second car sequence.
[*] Spelling mistake on torch pickup.
[*] Gearstick inconsistency in cafe exterior.
[*] Aneira wall placement when returning from cafe backrooms.
[*] Entering backrooms prior to equipping lighter blocking progress.
[*] Placing cup on counter during fadeout causing visual inconsistency.
[*] Car visibility when returning to cafe inconsistency.
[*] QOL - Route to cabin is now blocked prior to bunker discovery.
[*] QOL - Lighter/torch can now be equipped using number keys/dpad.
[/olist]

If you run into any issues please let me know here or in the game's discussion board.

Have fun!

notes.title: Chasing Static Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The Chasing Static demo is now available[/b][/h3]

We're really excited to share with you this early look into the world of Chasing Static. This short introduction to Chris's story will be available on Steam for a limited time.

[i]Seek shelter from a crushing storm as Chris Selwood, a man traveling through rural Northern
Wales in the dead of the night following his father’s funeral. After a warm coffee courtesy of a
charming waitress at a roadside café offers a short respite, Chris witnesses unspeakable terror
as he sees the waitress violently pinned to the ceiling by an indescribable monstrosity.[/i]

Thanks and have fun!
